name: @pipeworx/mcp-civitai

tools.name: search_models
tools.description: Search Civitai's catalog of community AI image-generation models (Stable Diffusion checkpoints, LoRAs, textual-inversion embeddings, ControlNets) by text query and/or type. Returns download stats, base model (SDXL / Pony / Flux / SD 1.5), creator and trained trigger words. Defaults to Safe-For-Work (mature content excluded). Keyless.

query.description: Text search over model names/descriptions, e.g. "realistic", "anime", "pixel art".

type.description: Model type filter. One of: Checkpoint, LORA, TextualInversion, LoCon, Controlnet.

sort.description: Sort order: "Highest Rated", "Most Downloaded", or "Newest". Default "Most Downloaded".

include_mature.description: Include mature/NSFW models. Default false (Safe-For-Work — sends nsfw=false to the API).

tools.name: get_model
tools.description: Get full details for a single Civitai model by id — description, type, creator, tags, download/rating stats, and every version with its base model, trigger words and downloadable files. Try id 4201 ("Realistic Vision V6.0 B1", a SFW checkpoint). Defaults Safe-For-Work; nsfw flag is surfaced. Keyless.

id.description: Civitai model id, e.g. 4201 (Realistic Vision), 133005 (Juggernaut XL).

tools.name: list_by_type
tools.description: Browse the top community models of a given type on Civitai (most-downloaded first), optionally filtered to a specific base model. Great for "best SDXL checkpoints" or "top Flux LoRAs". Defaults to Safe-For-Work (mature excluded). Keyless.

type.description: Model type. One of: Checkpoint, LORA, TextualInversion, LoCon, Controlnet.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-civitai forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the civitai pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
